path.fact: The unchanged conformance subprocess submits the real registered provider through RuntimeService for birth, grouped undo, then redo; no synthetic record enters the path.
Agent loads authenticated target history/boundaries, selects inverse records, and passes inverse_sources/inverse_records into execute; redo is a fresh inverse of the accepted undo receipt.

Agent apply_inverse replays selected records in reverse order, records reads/writes, builds inverse_stages, and retains native_write_range; physical owner filtering is applied after each stage before materialization projection.

CommitPatch.after projects each inverse stage against its prior stage, while finish emits ordered effects, effect ranges, commit.effect bindings and authenticated commit.materialization successor/edge bindings.
Runtime store validates the prepared provider record against the source/base closure, command inputs, continuations, history and sequential capture before publication.

At redo-birth, validate_step iterates a recorded native read and native_site delegates the occurrence collection alias to site; site finds a non-singleton occurrence match in that boundary and rejects.

The guard identifies the validation seam only. Without the exact redo records/bindings/stage closures, the evidence cannot distinguish an Agent-emitted wrong read or stage boundary from a Runtime boundary/projection mismatch, nor verify final effect/closure conservation.
